## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Woodpecker Furniture?
Plot No. 42, 7th Avenue, Besant Nagar, Chennai 600 090.

### What facilities does Woodpecker Furniture have?
Living room, Bedroom, Dining room, Office furniture, Storage & outdoor, Decor, lighting & rugs, Care4Ever free maintenance, 2-year written warranty, Try & Buy: one-week return.

### What is Try & Buy?
If the furniture doesn't fit your space, you can return it within one week of delivery, as long as it is undamaged and the packing is kept intact.

### What is Care4Ever?
Free maintenance for your Woodpecker furniture: cleaning, sanitizing, alignment correction, polish touch-up and a general check-up.

### How long is the warranty?
A 2-year written warranty.

### How do I plan a visit to Woodpecker Furniture?
Pick a date in the visit section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99404 62277.
